service: Global B2B Email, MX, SPF & DMARC Deliverability Auditor
description: High-speed asynchronous B2B email and corporate domain auditor via DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare & Google DNS). Validates RFC 5322 syntax, disposable domains, MX records, email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast), SPF, and DMARC policies.

inputSchema.title: Global B2B Email & Domain Deliverability, MX, SPF & DMARC Security Auditor Input

targets.title: Target Emails or Domains
targets.description: List of email addresses or domain names to audit

checkDmarcAndSpf.title: Audit SPF & DMARC Security Policies
checkDmarcAndSpf.description: Query TXT records for SPF and _dmarc policies

inputTarget.title: Input Target
inputTarget.description: Original email address or domain submitted for audit

isValidSyntax.title: Valid Syntax
isValidSyntax.description: Whether the input satisfies RFC 5322 email or DNS hostname syntax

isDisposable.title: Disposable Domain
isDisposable.description: Whether the domain belongs to a known temporary/disposable email provider

isRoleAccount.title: Role Account
isRoleAccount.description: Whether the email local-part is a generic role address (sales@, admin@, support@, etc.)

hasMxRecords.title: Has MX Records
hasMxRecords.description: Whether the domain has active Mail Exchange (MX) DNS records

emailProvider.title: Email Provider
emailProvider.description: Detected B2B email provider or gateway from MX records

hasSpf.title: Has SPF
hasSpf.description: Whether the domain publishes a valid v=spf1 TXT policy

hasDmarc.title: Has DMARC
hasDmarc.description: Whether _dmarc.<domain> publishes a valid v=DMARC1 TXT policy

dmarcPolicy.title: DMARC Policy
dmarcPolicy.description: Extracted DMARC enforcement policy (reject, quarantine, none, missing, or skipped)

deliverabilityScore.title: Deliverability Score
deliverabilityScore.description: Composite B2B deliverability and domain security score (0-100)

x402Challenge.error: Payment Required: Submit a valid Solana USDC transfer proof in the X-PAYMENT header.
